message.content: The rerun reproduces the scattered fluence with a smooth depth dependence (0.167 at 0.1 cm rising to 0.421 at 5 cm). I'll now point the analysis at the new tallies and add the electron-kernel depth-dose convolution for D(z), dmax, PDD and β.
message.reasoning:
The scattered fluence values look monotonic across depth, increasing from 0.167 at 0.1 cm to 0.421 at 5 cm, which checks out. Now I need to update ana2/ana3 to reference SM2.pkl and switch the DET index from 4 to 10 for the 5 cm case, adjusting the SM reference loops and pickled path accordingly, along with the depth list for K.

For ana3, I need to recompute m1 (the mean free path λ) from the electron angular distribution — earlier it came out around 0.096 cm, so I should verify that value holds after the index switch. Then for ana4, I'm setting up D(z) as a convolution of the kernel K(z'−x) with an exponential weighting e^(−x/λ)/λ, where K combines an analytic primary term (with inverse-square falloff) plus the scattered component interpolated from the Monte Carlo grid across depths 0 to 7 cm — extrapolating beyond that range only if needed, though for D(5) the relevant range stays within bounds. I'm working out how to handle K near z'=0, where the scattered kernel needs careful interpolation since there's no clean value right at the surface.

Below 0.1 cm I'm linearly extrapolating K using the nearest MC grid points (0.1 and 0.25), giving an estimated surface value around 0.152, while using primary analytic values everywhere else since that part has a closed-form solution. I'm then planning to compute D(z) over a fine grid from 0.1 to 7 cm, find dmax via the peak, derive PDD5 as 100×D(5)/D(dmax), compute β as D(5)/K(5), and convert D(5) to dose per fluence using the standard MeV-to-Gray conversion factor, making sure the kernel still integrates to unity for energy conservation. I'm also sanity-checking whether λ≈0.1 cm produces a dmax near 0.5 cm, which would match earlier buildup estimates — now I'm about to write the code to compute all this.

function.arguments:
{"code": "
import re as _re
src=open('/tmp/work/ana2.py').read()
src=src.replace("/tmp/work/SM.pkl","/tmp/work/SM2.pkl")
src=_re.sub(r"SM\['(hE|g|gE|hC|int|trE|kcol|kgross)'\]\[4\]", lambda m: "SM['%s'][10]"%m.group(1), src)
src=src.replace("SM['kcol'][4]","SM['kcol'][10]")
open('/tmp/work/ana2.py','w').write(src)
src3=open('/tmp/work/ana3.py').read()
src3=_re.sub(r"SM\['(hE|g|gE|hC|int|trE|kcol|kgross)'\]\[4\]", lambda m: "SM['%s'][10]"%m.group(1), src3)
src3=src3.replace("SM['kcol'][4]","SM['kcol'][10]")
# depth list for Kd: use all depths from mc3
src3=src3.replace("depth_list=[0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0,5.0]","depth_list=[0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5,3.0,4.0,5.0,6.0,7.0]")
src3=src3.replace("    Kd.append(pz+SM['kcol'][j]*F)","    Kd.append(pz+SM['kcol'][j]*F)")
open('/tmp/work/ana3.py','w').write(src3)
import re
print(re.findall(r"SM\['[a-zA-Z0-9_]+'\]\[\d+\]", src+src3))
"}
